_comment: Bundled default banner set (portrait / skyscraper, 300x600). Shipped with every Community release so the carousel always has content when the banner subdomain is unreachable (isolated server, blocked outbound, CSP block, timeout). The live feed on banner.felixschaller.com uses the same shape and overrides this set when reachable. Creatives are self-contained SVGs in this folder (brand logos embedded); links must stay on an allowed first-party host (felixschaller.com, xixum.ai, af-ax.com) or they are stripped.
